children: NextTrip announced JOURNY TV will premiere its first original series, I DO: In Destination, on October 4 and 5, 2026.
JOURNY TV will debut I DO: In Destination across its global streaming network Oct 4–5, 2026, followed by a YouTube release.
Series integrates with NextTrip’s content-to-commerce strategy to drive travel inspiration into bookings and engagement.
Episodes 1 and 2 filmed at Paradisus Cancún and Paradisus Palma Real showcase resorts as travel and wedding destinations.
Third episode planned to film in Nassau, The Bahamas, in Oct 2026 with support from The Bahamas Ministry of Tourism.
Series offers marketing/commercial opportunities for destinations, hospitality partners, advertisers and sponsors.
